sources.title: Movimiento estudiantil de Serbia anuncia a profesor de química como su candidato presidencial
sources.excerpt:
BELGRADO, Serbia (AP) — El movimiento estudiantil de Serbia anunció el viernes la candidatura del profesor de química Radomir Saicic para las próximas elecciones presidenciales anticipadas, que se celebrarán el 27 de diciembre.

La votación presidencial llega luego que el movimiento estudiantil derrotara al Partido Progresista Serbio (SNS, por sus siglas en serbio), de derecha, del expresidente Aleksandar Vucic, en unas elecciones parlamentarias anticipadas el 25 de octubre.

Vucic renunció a la presidencia en septiembre para perseguir lo que terminó siendo un intento fallido de convertirse en el próximo primer ministro, después que él y su partido gobernaran prácticamente sin oposición durante 14 años.
sources.limits: AP原文由Reading Eagle刊载西班牙语译文；发布时间由搜索结果给出，文章页面显示11月27日09:41 EDT（14:41Z），不将更新时刻当作首发时刻。

sources.title: Lula’s choice of Bradesco banker as Brazil’s finance minister lifts markets
sources.excerpt:
RIO DE JANEIRO (AP) — Brazilian markets rallied on Friday after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva confirmed that he had chosen a veteran banker to lead the finance ministry in 2027, a move seen as a sign of his commitment to fiscal discipline.

Brazil’s currency, the real, and its stock market had tumbled after Lula’s surprise victory over Flávio Bolsonaro in last month’s presidential election. Investors had been counting on a win by Bolsonaro, who had pledged to slash spending.

But the announcement late Thursday that Bradesco's Luiz Carlos Trabuco, chairman of the board, had accepted Lula’s invitation to oversee the country’s finances during his upcoming fourth term, which begins Jan. 5, triggered a sharp rebound.
sources.limits: 市场价格变动及任命信息据AP报道；未另行取得政府任命公告或交易所原始行情序列。

sources.title: A Ukraine loan is in limbo after EU budget talks stall. Leaders will try again in 3 weeks
sources.excerpt:
BRUSSELS (AP) — After struggling to chaperone Europe’s leaders through more than 12 hours of high-stakes budget negotiations, European Council President António Costa faced reporters early Friday with a stark assessment. “We didn’t reach an agreement,” he said.

Government leaders of the 27-nation European Union failed to narrow down the size of the 2028-2034 budget — let alone how it might be used. An important loan for Ukraine was caught up in the wrangling.

In three weeks, they will try again.
sources.limits: 仅据AP对峰会及谈判的报道；未读取欧盟会议纪要或预算正式文件。

sources.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
sources.excerpt:
Two workers for the medical charity Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) have been killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza, according to the organisation.

MSF said the strike was a direct hit on one of the charity's clinics, the location of which was known by the Israeli military.

In a statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said the two people were Hamas operatives "acting as security guards at a clinic operated by MSF". The IDF added the strike was "not directed at a hospital" and caused no damage to medical infrastructure.

The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) said that attacks on health facilities and health workers in Gaza were "outrageous and unacceptable".

sections.title: 提名把议会胜势带入总统竞选
paragraphs: 提名的政治意义在于学生运动继续推动权力交接，而非总统职位本身拥有广泛行政权。AP称该运动在10月议会选举击败前总统武契奇所属政党；赛契奇承诺遵守职权并公开说明决定。此承诺与前任被指扩大总统权力的争议形成对照，但能否落实取决于后续选举结果及制度运行。

sections.title: 竞选仍待其他候选人与选举进程检验
paragraphs: 可检验的后续节点是其他政党是否提名或抵制候选人，以及12月27日投票结果。AP报道提名当时其他候选人尚未确定；总统在宪法上的职责边界也将影响竞选承诺的可执行性。
